info.title: MisarDev Actions
info.description: Create, build and deploy projects, roll back with checkpoints, connect custom domains, and search your code and the web — from any AI assistant.

post.description: List the projects you own or can access, newest first, with cursor pagination. view=active (default) hides archived and trashed projects; pass view=archived or view=trash to see those.

cursor.description: Project ID to start after (from the previous page)

view.description: Which lifecycle view to list (default active)

result.description: The tool's output — text or JSON.

402.description: Plan limit — the body carries code: plan_limit_exceeded and an upgrade offer

429.description: Rate limited, or a quota block carrying code: plan_limit_exceeded

post.description: Get one project by ID — name, description, settings, visibility, version and deployment fields. Read this before update_project so you change the current version, not a stale copy.

post.description: Update a project's name, description, files, settings or visibility. Files passed here REPLACE the matching paths. Pass the `version` you read with get_project to avoid overwriting someone else's newer edit (the API answers 409 on a conflict).

files.description: File map to write: path → content

is_public.description: Make the project public (true) or private (false)

version.description: Version read from get_project, for conflict detection
